item.text: The existing hero is exactly in the wrong direction the brief describes: translucent shell, serif headline, floating trust/value layers, and a very ornamental right side. I’m pulling the rest of the file now and checking the live reference so I can replace that with a firmer sales-first split without touching later sections.

The reference signal is clear enough now: plain commercial headline, short supporting line, a compact checklist of outcomes, one strong CTA, and a single clean media block on the right. I’m mapping the local file so I can replace only that first section and leave the rest of the page and the popup script untouched.

I’ve isolated the edit boundary. The first section runs through the hero markup only, and the popup lives below it as a separate block, so I can do a hard hero rewrite without risking later sections or the modal script.
